stories.title: American Well President Phyllis Gotlib Sells $86,801 in AMWL Stock
stories.summary: Phyllis Gotlib, president of American Well, sold $86,801 worth of AMWL stock. Investing.com reported the sale, based on an insider trading filing. The filing does not state a reason for the sale.
stories.whyItMatters: Insider sales can signal how executives view their own company's stock, though one sale of this size is not conclusive.
whatToWatch: Future insider filings from American Well executives
questions: What share of Gotlib's total holdings does this sale represent?
Did other American Well insiders sell stock around the same time?

stories.title: Oil Prices Dip After Trump Announces Russia-Ukraine Energy Ceasefire
stories.summary: Oil prices fell after President Trump announced an energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine. Investing.com reported the drop. The announcement eases concern about supply disruption tied to the conflict.
stories.whyItMatters: A ceasefire on energy targets could lower the war risk premium built into oil prices.
whatToWatch: Further statements from Russia or Ukraine on its terms
questions: What does the ceasefire cover, beyond energy targets?
How long is the ceasefire meant to last?

sources.title: Oil prices dip after Trump announces Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire

stories.title: One Dead in New Attack on Saudi Airport, a Day After Houthi Strike Killed 13
stories.summary: An attack on a Saudi airport killed one person, Investing.com reported. The attack came a day after a Houthi strike on the same region killed 13 people.
stories.whyItMatters: Attacks near Saudi energy and transit infrastructure raise the risk of supply disruption and feed into oil price moves.
whatToWatch: Saudi or coalition response to the attacks
questions: Who carried out the latest attack?
Can the airport continue normal operations?

stories.title: Monopar Therapeutics Director Christopher Starr Sells $659k in Shares
stories.summary: Christopher Starr, a director at Monopar Therapeutics, sold shares worth $659,000, Investing.com reported. The report is based on an insider trading filing.
stories.whyItMatters: Large director sales at a small biotech draw attention from investors who track insider sentiment.
whatToWatch: Additional insider filings from Monopar Therapeutics
questions: What share of Starr's total holdings did he sell?
Did the sale follow a pre-scheduled trading plan?

stories.title: UK Finance Minister to Urge Major Economies to Rein In Borrowing at IMF
stories.summary: The UK finance minister plans to call on large economies to get their borrowing under control at an IMF meeting, Investing.com reported. The call points to concern about rising government debt levels.
stories.whyItMatters: Pressure on major economies to cut borrowing can affect bond yields and fiscal policy debates worldwide.
whatToWatch: The finance minister's remarks at the IMF meeting
questions: Which countries is the finance minister targeting?
Does the UK face the same pressure to cut its own borrowing?

sources.title: UK finance minister to call for big economies to get borrowing under control at IMF

stories.title: Oil Climbs as Middle East Conflict and Tanker Attacks Persist
stories.summary: Oil prices rose as conflict in the Middle East and attacks on tankers continued, Investing.com reported. The ongoing instability keeps supply risk in focus for oil markets.
stories.whyItMatters: Sustained Middle East conflict and tanker attacks threaten oil supply routes and can push energy prices higher.
whatToWatch: Further tanker attacks or shipping disruptions
Any diplomatic moves to de-escalate the conflict
questions: Which shipping routes face the greatest risk?
Are oil producers adjusting output in response?

sources.title: Oil climbs as Mideast conflict, tanker attacks persist
